description.value: Auto Strada is the Vancouver House osteria of Autostrada, a BC Italian restaurant group offering thoughtful Italian cuisine in a full sit-down setting near the base of downtown Vancouver. The kitchen emphasizes house-made pastas, locally sourced seafood, and classic Italian preparations by a chef with over 20 years of Italian cooking experience. Private dining for up to 68 guests and event catering are also available, making it a viable stop for group cycling tours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Vancouver House / Osteria location of Autostrada, a two-location Italian restaurant group, with the matching phone 604.258.9988 cited on the front page for Vancouver. Online ordering links ('ONLINE ORDERS: VANCOUVER') confirm takeout is available. The menu shows clearly vegetarian pasta dishes (Rigatoni Alla Norma – eggplant/pomodoro, Bucatini Cacio e Pepe – pecorino/pepper) and salads as positive evidence of vegetarian options. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name 'Auto Strada' (two words) differs from the website's branding 'Autostrada' (one word) — minor spelling discrepancy.
The website represents a two-location hospitality group; the OSM record and phone number correspond specifically to the Vancouver House / Osteria location, not the Britannia Beach Oyster Bar & Grill.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Italian restaurant in downtown Vancouver with confirmed online ordering and a full dine-in menu — a useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu shows multiple vegetarian pasta options including Rigatoni Alla Norma (eggplant, pomodoro, chili, parmigiano) and Bucatini Cacio e Pepe (pecorino, black pepper), plus vegetarian salads and antipasti. No vegan or GF labelling confirmed
